name: westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_on_init
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog::OnInitDialog loads two saved WOL profile strings, populates the profile combo, initializes connect-string state, and selects the first profile.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The WOL API object, MFC CDialog::OnInitDialog, USER32 SendMessageA, zLoc, and CWnd::SetWindowTextA are verified as provider boundaries by smoke-test patches rather than by live UI or network provider execution.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x441a40 validates a thiscall BOOL method that calls CDialog::OnInitDialog, calls the WOL API provider slot at offset 0x90 for profile ids 1 and 2, falls back to the empty string on provider failure, copies player/connect strings into saved and active CString arrays, inserts display labels with CB_INSERTSTRING, writes item data with CB_SETITEMDATA, initializes modes and the selected/dirty fields, selects index 0, sets the edit text from profile 0, and returns TRUE.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_on_init_smoke patches the MFC, WOL API, USER32, zLoc, and CWnd providers and verifies both provider loads, CString field copies, unnamed-profile localization for an empty player name, CB_INSERTSTRING/CB_SETITEMDATA/CB_SETCURSEL message order and arguments, connect-string modes, selected index, dirty flag, and initial edit text.
